errors.message: WSD aborts inside the AutoTSAD method-local execution interface while computing the 12 selection/normalization/aggregation metric combinations. Failing call: autotsad/system/execution/remote_func_test_combination.py:54 passes the binarized ensemble `combined_score > 0` as y_pred into autotsad/evaluation.py:compute_metrics, which at evaluation.py:198-205 casts it with `y_pred.astype(np.int_)` and dispatches to timeeval RangePrecision -> prts ts_precision -> prts/base/time_series_metrics.py:_prepare_data. There the assertion `np.allclose(np.unique(values_pred), [0, 1]) or np.allclose(np.unique(values_pred), [1])` fires because for the failing combination `combined_score > 0` is single-valued (all-False, unique == [0]) - the aggregation step (autotsad/system/execution/aggregation.py:56-82, notably the custom SigmaThresholding path that zeroes non-predicted entries before np.nanmax) can produce a combined score whose binarization contains no positive entry, and prts does not accept a degenerate prediction vector. The label side is sound: datasets/UTS/WSD/99/test_label.npy is shape [18236], dtype float64, unique_values [0.0, 1.0] and datasets/UTS/WSD/93/test_label.npy is shape [18227], dtype float64, unique_values [0.0, 1.0], so the firing assertion is the prediction-side one, not the real-label one; an empty-but-valid prediction would otherwise fail later at `predicted_anomalies_[0]`. This is an interface/degenerate-input error in the method-local execution layer, not a low-score or scientific-fidelity concern. Repair: guard the degenerate prediction vector inside the AutoTSAD method directory only - in remote_func_test_combination.py (and/or evaluation.py:compute_metrics) skip/short-circuit metric computation when `combined_score > 0` has no positive entry (and when y_score is constant), mirroring the existing in-repo precedent at autotsad/system/execution/remote_func_execute.py:30-33 (`if np.any(dataset.label): ... else: return -1.`), so the combination yields a defined neutral metric instead of an AssertionError and execute_and_rank can rank/select and export results. Do not modify EasyTSAD shared metrics, benchmark labels under datasets/UTS/WSD/, the evaluation definition, or AutoTSAD algorithm semantics; keep the flat method layout and envs/autotsad. Existing per-curve score caches for run 20261112T114234Z (scores/93.npy ... scores/99.npy) are safe to reuse, so only metric aggregation and ranking need to be re-run for WSD. Resume only TODS, AIOPS, WSD, Yahoo and UCR full (non-smoke) runs to completion and then export results; NAB run 20261112T114234Z is already successful and its published metrics must be preserved and not re-trained.

evidence.note: Failing call site: metrics.update(compute_metrics(dataset.label, combined_score, combined_score > 0)) - binarized ensemble can be all-False for a combination, and prts asserts on the single-valued prediction.

compute_metrics casts the prediction with y_pred = y_pred.astype(np.int_) and at line 205 dispatches metric(y_label, y_pred) into timeeval RangePrecision -> prts ts_precision where _prepare_data asserts.
aggregate_scores max/mean/custom; the custom path zeroes non-predicted entries and applies np.nanmax, which is how a combination can yield a combined score with no positive entry.
In-repo precedent for the degenerate-input guard that the repair should mirror in the method-local execution layer.
Labels are not degenerate: shape [18236], dtype float64, unique_values [0.0, 1.0] - confirms the firing assertion is prediction-side, and labels must not be modified.
